summary:
I re-checked all 19 capabilities against main at 15e78e276 (worktree HEAD confirmed 15e78e2761b9). Of the checks, 17 hold on status and 2 do not. node_modules is absent, so no vitest ran; behaviour claims rest on code-path reading, git history and gh, plus the screenshot manifest.

**The grounding is accurate on the load-bearing facts.** Each of these was confirmed at the cited or equivalent lines:
- BookReader requires a book_assets row. register_source_document never creates one, so URL, Exa and Parallel ingests 404.
- Four broken doors: ChunkModal's plain `<a href>` into the /wrestle upload screen; openPdfPanel and ProjectTree ⌘-click opening PdfViewer with no bytes (`pdfBytes.slice()` on undefined); ClaimInspector passing claimId where ClaimCard needs a claim.
- `openWindow('reader')` has exactly one caller, the DRW canvas 'read source', and the evidenceSourceContext payload is never read.
- Commit 2ff9518e6 replaced the reader's floating ChaseThread with spin-and-navigate. That left the ReadingCompanion handoff and source-merge chain with no writer.
- The passage→research helpers have no endpoint.
- The antiek-reader, w3, w7 and source-merge branches are all NOT_MERGED. PR #2846 is OPEN and #3384 is MERGED.

**Failed or corrected:**
- **RE-18 (hotkeys) is not ABSENT; corrected to PARTIAL.** WorkspaceWindow has wired window-local keys: Esc closes, Enter/F toggles full, arrows move, ⌘+arrows resize. A complete per-entity hop system (AssignHotkey plus persisted custom bindings that dispatch on load, including `/read/<id>`) is built, but no product surface mounts `<AssignHotkey>`.
- **The craft claim that ReadingColumn is uncapped is wrong.** The parent sets `max-w-2xl` (672px). The real defect is that the cap is too wide for the 60–78 character target.

**Wrong supporting details inside claims that otherwise hold:**
- The RE-09 note that 'Write is the only product where highlight-to-island survives' is false. The Research workstation's HighlightToolbar still opens a floating ChaseThread, and DRW BlockDetail hosts FloatMenu deep-research.
- RE-09's PRIOR screenshot-manifest evidence is mis-cited. Only 3 of 6 ClaimCard stories crash, all on 'length' in the grounding-prop stories, so they do not show the ClaimInspector bug.
- RE-11's 'only logged to the console' is incomplete. A capacity-exhausted spin raises a toast.
- RE-15's 'never saved with offsets' misses PdfViewer's `document.region_selected` event, which carries page, char offsets and bbox (though only on the unreachable PDF path).

**Mis-scoped capabilities:**
- **RE-12:** misses the wired ContextPicker in the AI sidecar (POST /compose-context), and that 'Research this page' already seeds a research agent with the whole page when nothing is highlighted.
- **RE-13:** the 'dig deeper on an existing thread' contract already exists as DRW steer deepen/redirect.
- **RE-14:** a manual research-thread merge is wired in Research (ArtifactOutlineShelf in DistillView).
- **RE-16:** WorkspaceStore layout persistence per investigation already exists to extend.
- **RE-07 needs strengthening:** DRW web-found sources go through ingest_url, so the one shipped reader embed shows "That book isn't in the library." for them (by code path; NOT MEASURED).

**Other missed capabilities:**
- The panel pop-out to a separate OS window (/_panel/:panelId).
- The in-place, multi-turn FloatMenu Dialogue over a highlighted passage.

**Coordination:** I did not message the 'Antiek Sweep' peer session. This subagent has no verified channel to it, and cross-session coordination belongs to the orchestrator. No scratch files were needed under /tmp/mothership-ground/reading-embedded-refute/.
